banner: We use Google Analytics cookies, and a cookie and a random visitor ID of our own that remember which link brought you here and record which pages you open, which sign-up buttons you press and whether you start to sign up, to understand how visitors use this site and which channels bring sign-ups. They’re only set if you accept. Until you choose, Google Analytics receives a basic page-visit signal (including your IP address) but sets no cookie; if you decline, it receives nothing more. Declining changes nothing about what you can do here. Read our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> for details.
summary: We use cookies to measure visits and sign-ups, but only if you accept.
